plan.summary: This 4-week opening block fits an off-camp 12-week boxing strength-and-power cycle. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body lift so later percentage work is grounded in a real number, and the main build starts in Week 2. With only one 30-minute S&C session each week, the plan stays full-body, keeps power first, then one main strength lift, then a small amount of practical upper-body and trunk work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and power with simple high-value lifts that do not interfere too much with boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength and power work while keeping total fatigue low enough for skill training.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength, sharpen power and speed, and carry the earlier work into faster cleaner output.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then build to one hard clean set of 3-5 reps. Stop if technique breaks and log the load and reps carefully.
